subsetPolicyRationale: `s.procedural.generation3d@1` is this plugin's own self-contained 3D procedural generation graph — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-widget, update-widget, delete-widget, connect-synapse, update-synapse, disconnect-synapse, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
